brv_wh_boss_10.m: Hey! Are you the new worker?
r: Insolence! Who do you think you are?

brv_wh_boss_10_10.m: How do you get on with the work?
r: I'm not quite done yet. I just want to take a short break.
Please tell me again, what I should do.
I found 10 pairs of each item.

brv_wh_boss_10_12.m: I'm not paying you to laze around! Back to work!

brv_wh_boss_10_22.m: 10 pairs! Great - but where are they? I don't see them.
r: Oh, I must have lost some. Wait a second...

brv_wh_boss_10_30.m: 10 pairs - that is correct. So everything is in order.

brv_wh_boss_10_32.m: Good work! I am very pleased with you.
r: I am glad. How much do I actually get for this work?

brv_wh_boss_10_90.m: Good work gives good wages! Here is 100 gold.

brv_wh_boss_12.m: It took you long to get here! I hope you are not always that slow.

brv_wh_boss_20.m: I need someone to check if all the items are still in the storage.

brv_wh_boss_22.m: I always buy a pair of any item. So it would be best if you find the pairs.

brv_wh_boss_24.m: Each time you find a pair, take it out of the storage bin!

brv_wh_boss_30.m: Come back to me when you found all the pairs and tell me how many there are.
r: OK. I'll be back in a minute.
Eh, what do you want me to do exactly?

brv_wh_boss_40.m: OK: Go to the storage and take out an item.

brv_wh_boss_42.m: Then go and look for the another item of the same kind. So then you'll have a pair of them.

brv_wh_boss_44.m: After that take another item, and look for the second one to get a pair again.

brv_wh_boss_46.m: Do this for all pairs, until you have found every one.

brv_wh_boss_48.m:
If you have one item in hand, and in the next there is an item that doesn't match, then both items automatically go back to their bin.
So be sure to take the items in pairs.

r: I shall get the items, one by one.
Not necessary. I'll be back in a minute.
I shall find them in the right order: Pair after pair.

brv_wh_boss_900_10.m: I have no work for you at the moment.

brv_wh_delivery_boss_10.m: Ah! You have finally returned, my new worker.
r: How may I be of service?

brv_wh_delivery_boss_10_10.m: You are back. Did you deliver all of the items?

brv_wh_delivery_boss_10_10_no.m: Then what are you standing there for?! Get out and deliver everything!

brv_wh_delivery_boss_10_10_yes.m: That's nice to hear. Then you can now give me the... eh...330 gold pieces that you should have received from the sales.
r: Uh, I had expenses along the way and I don't have all the gold anymore.

brv_wh_delivery_boss_10_10_yes_1.m: And then you walk into my sight? Go get my gold!
r: Oh, I just found the 330 gold pieces in my pocket. Please take it.

brv_wh_delivery_boss_10_10_yes_10.m: Good job! I am glad that you work responsibly.

brv_wh_delivery_boss_20.m: I need someone to deliver all of the items that are in storage.

brv_wh_delivery_boss_30.m: Come back to me when you have delivered all of the items. The order is not important. Here is the list of customers.
r: You want me to deliver these items to your customers?

brv_wh_delivery_boss_40.m: Yes yes, hurry now. I have work to do here.
r: Hope I get paid better this time.

brv_wh_delivery_boss_reward.m: That is serious. And here you have your well-deserved reward: 100 gold.
